note: Doane Valley Campground in Palomar Mountain State Park, in conifer forest near Doane Pond. From SR-76 the gentler County Road S7 (via Lake Henshaw) is the route for trailers and heavy rigs; S6 from Rincon Springs is steep and winding. No gas on the mountain. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov page + infosheet + brochure map + ReserveCalifornia API read. $40 confirmed ($38 senior), extra vehicle $10 (2 max); max rig 27->24 (park page, trailer and motorhome both 24); 31 sites, 12 RC sites take 24 ft+; season approx May-Oct -> 04-01..11-30 (RC calendar); 14-night max; no closure banner. Pin 1.4 km off (at HQ). Not waterfront kept.
